profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I am a Staff Software Engineer and Technical Leader specializing in building, optimizing, and productionizing large-scale machine learning systems, generative AI frameworks, and autonomous agent infrastructure. Over my tenure at Google DeepMind and YouTube, I have focused on bridging the gap between cutting-edge ML research and production infrastructure at massive scale.  
My core expertise spans:

- Autonomous Agents: Engineering core serving, tooling, and communication frameworks for next-generation enterprise autonomous coding agents.  

- Generative AI & Media Foundations: Leading infrastructure teams for large-scale training and inference optimization of state-of-the-art diffusion models (including Imagen, VideoPoet, and Veo).  

- Distributed Systems & Core ML Tooling: Serving as an organization-wide expert in JAX, TensorFlow, and TPU-accelerated infrastructure to maximize system performance and efficiency.  

- Recommendation Frameworks: Deep experience architecting heavy-duty, production-critical recommendation algorithms and deep learning pipelines handling billions of engagements (YouTube & LinkedIn).  

Whether directing cross-functional engineering teams or architecting low-latency system infrastructure from the ground up, I focus on building technical foundations that unlock the true production capability of AI.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and scaled high-performance infrastructure bridging AI research and production deployment. Led engineering initiatives across three strategic domains: productionizing of models, developing fully autonomous coding agents, and pioneering continuous reinforcement learning pipelines.

1. Productionization & Inference
Hardware-Aware Acceleration: Managed the end-to-end lifecycle of transitioning research/training models onto inference TPUs, optimizing low-level compilation to minimize latency and maximize throughput.
Distributed Memory Systems: Engineered memory sharding, model parallelism, and tensor-splitting strategies to deploy Image, Video, Embedding, and LLM architectures within strict hardware constraints.
Model verification: Verification of numerical fidelity to ensure zero-drift performance

2. Autonomous Coding Agent Development
Agentic Architecture: Designed robust agent harnesses, orchestration loops, and state machines governing the reasoning, planning for autonomous internal coding agents.
Tool & Runtime Integration: Engineered high-throughput communication protocols connecting agent frontends to stateful, secure backend execution environments for safe code execution.

3. Continuous Reinforcement Learning (RL) Infrastructure
Framework Migration: Led the porting of legacy configurations and reward pipelines to state-of-the-art, distributed RL frameworks.
Embedding Optimization: Applied advanced RL techniques to fine-tune Gemini embedding models, driving measurable gains in downstream task accuracy and semantic retrieval performance.


Systems: TPUArchitecture, Memory Sharding, Model Parallelism, Distributed Compute, Secure Sandboxed Runtimes.
AI/ML: LLMs, Text-to-Image/Video, Multimodal Embeddings, Policy Optimization.
Frameworks: JAX, XLA, TensorFlow, gRPC, various internal frameworks.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Software Infrastructure · Reinforcement Learning · Network Design · autonomous agent design · TPU productionization

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Team-lead of Job Recommendations
positions.description:
Team-lead / Engineering manager for LinkedIn's Jobs You May Be Interested In (JYMBII) recommendation team.  JYMBII is a large-scale job recommendation system and is a corner stone of the LinkedIn Talent Solutions business.

Team-lead responsibilities:

- Directing day-to-day operations of 8+ member team 
- Managing team member career development
- Acting as technical Product Manager, determining, in cooperation with the product team, the strategic direction of the Jobs recommendation product
- Planing yearly and quarterly objectives and key results

Individual contributor responsibilities:

- Performing data-collection, feature engineer, and machine learning to model job recommendations using a variety of technologies and tools, including R, Hadoop, Pig, and large scale distributed machine learning frameworks
- Designing and implementing Java-based system infrastructure required to calculate and serve recommendations
- Monitoring online model performance metrics used to make statistically sound model deployment decisions
- Involved extensively in horizontal system planning & engineering of shared recommendation platform and machine-learning pipeline
